title: Histological evaluation of two different anorganic bovine bone matrixes in lateral wall sinus elevation procedure: A retrospective study
authors: Mahesh L, Mascarenhas G, Bhasin MT, Guirado C, Juneja S. Natl J Maxillofac Surg. 2020 Jul - Dec;11(2):258-262. doi: 10.4103/njms.NJMS_81_19.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The results of the study illustrates that both the bone substitute materials allow predictable new bone formation in sinus augmentation procedures” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
